snippet.title: Soap Slide Trailer
snippet.description: Soap Slide is a chaotic and fun party game set in a pastel world where soaps race by sliding. You can play solo or co-op with friends. Steam Link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3983090/Soap_Slide/
